what_went_wrong: The search found a relevant comparison page (goodflightdeals) but the drafts took a 12 kg LATAM figure from it. The compositor kept that figure, invented an Azul size, never gave the 55 × 35 × 25 cm size for any carrier and left out gate weighing.
great_answer_would: State in two lines that all three carriers allow 10 kg at 55 × 35 × 25 cm including wheels plus an under-seat item, that it is weighed at the gate and that some fares restrict it, then give a compact packing list aimed at 7-8 kg with laundry every 5-7 days.
notes: GOL's 10 kg included on every fare matches the sheet and source 8's title. The packing list is reasonable but generic: no merino, no type N adapter or voltage note, no laundry plan, no sub-10 kg target. It is dated only by 'double-check the latest policies', with no 'as of'. It also misses that a US 22 × 14 × 9 in roller is slightly too long.
